title: 企業価値評価とＥＳＧ
subtitle: Valuation and ESG
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning and educational goal of the Department of Management Systems. The goal is to give students an understanding of the basic concept of valuation, an important element in business restructuring, M&A, and investment, and to impart the skills necessary to properly calculate valuation. Furthermore, the goal is to understand the basic concept of "ESG" that influences the sustainable generation of cash flow, which is the basis of corporate valuation.
advice:
Since this course is a finance-related application course, the focus is not only on the acquisition of knowledge and skills related to valuation, but also on the development of judgment regarding specific cases.
Therefore, active research and enthusiastic class participation are required.
requiredKnowledge:
This course deals with financial management from the perspective of capital procurement.
Students should review the topics and tools covered in the contents of finance-related classes prior to attending class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the importance of considering valuation from various perspectives.
Be able to understand the meaning and calculation of ROIC.
Be able to calculate enterprise value using the DCF method.
Be able to understand the meaning of shareholder value and be able to calculate it for specific examples.
Be able to understand the importance of valuation by studying case examples.
Be able to understand the basic concepts of ESG.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・Be able to understand the importance of valuation and find appropriate research cases from the daily news.
・Be able to understand ROIC and be able to use it for valuation.
・Be able to understand the DCF method and be able to use the method to calculate enterprise value.
・Be able to understand the practical application of valuation from the case examples introduced in class and be able to clearly explain the examples.
・Be able to understand the basic concepts of ESG and explain your thoughts.
achievementLevels.standard:
・Be able to understand the importance of valuation.
・Be able to understand ROIC and be able to calculate it.
・Be able to understand the DCF method and use it to calculate enterprise value.
・Be able to understand the practical application of valuation from the case examples introduced in the class.
・Be able to understand the basic concepts of ESG.

The goal is to give students an understanding of the basic concept of valuation, an important element in business restructuring, M&A, and investment, and to impart the skills necessary to properly calculate valuation.
